# victorops_user_devices (Data Source)

Get a user's contact devices. Note: Devices can only be created via the mobile app.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "victorops_user_devices" "jdane" {
  username = "jdane"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `username` (String) The username of the user.

### Read-Only

- `devices` (List of Object) The user's devices. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--devices))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--devices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `devices`

Read-Only:

- `device_type` (String)
- `ext_id` (String)
- `label` (String)
